---
description: lore_read as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
arguments:
  ids: The ids of the entries to read, such as e-112 or w-31.
---
Reads lore entries in full, each with its title, its source, the words that activate it and who may know it. Its secrets are shown as secrets, with their ids and who holds them.
